name: filmcraft
notes: Consumed at runtime by server/install.mjs through shared/install.mjs validatePin, planInstall and installPinned. Pinned 2026-11-04 to the v0.17.0 release (published 2026-11-03). Digests copied from the release's SHA256SUMS.txt and byte counts from GitHub asset metadata; the installer rejects a download whose size or SHA-256 differs. macOS needs the separately pinned filmcraft-cli payload from the same release; the Windows portable ZIP and the Linux tarball carry the CLI. licenseFiles names the upstream notices the installer must find in the unpacked tree or supplement from notices.json at the same tag; the v0.17.0 NOTICE adds the egui dependency font licences. Since v0.13.0 the control port answers only requests carrying the FILMCRAFT_CONTROL_TOKEN the app was started with; the adapter generates one per launch and keeps it in a private file. Only this URL is downloaded; never the latest release.
